lines.t: Namaste. Three pieces are gone from our storage hall.
A brass ceremonial vessel, a carved sandstone rosette, and a palm-leaf manuscript.
Please find them before the festival.
Stay calm and touch nothing. Every small detail matters.
Did anyone see something?
Meera was up before sunrise. Ask her.

choices.text: Why do these pieces matter so much?

lines.t: They carry the community's memory. Families have cared for them for generations.
(These objects are fictional, made for this story.)

choices.text: Who can open the storage hall?

lines.t: Only temple staff know where the key is kept. That is what worries me.
I'll speak to Meera, then see the hall.
Before sunrise I saw two men near the storage door.
One wore a red scarf. The other wore a black hood.
Thank you, Meera. That helps a lot.
Past the outer shrine, toward the old jungle path.
Cloth bundles. They held them carefully, like they knew their worth.
Three empty cloth-lined stands. Whoever came knew the hall.
Only temple staff know where the key is kept.
The lock was forced anyway. They wanted it to look like strangers.
The outer shrine is through that passage. Go carefully.
Muddy bootprints, two different sizes, and red silk caught on the door.
That cloth is not ours.
And a broken lamp. Someone knocked it over in a hurry.
Two suspects: the red scarf and the black hood. Just as Meera said.
Toward the old wall. Few people know it is a door.
Someone told them about the key. But these boots are not from here.
My grandfather spoke of a wall that opens when four symbols face the rising sun.
Lotus, conch, wheel, kalash. Then turn the centre wheel.
Four symbols in order, then the centre. Let's try.
The passage is open. They went this way.
Keep moving. The investigator is close.
I told you the lamp would leave marks.
It's over. Return what belongs to the community.
Two boot sizes, your red silk on the door, and the lamp you broke.
Do you know what these fetch?
Their value isn't money. It's memory.

choices.text: Put them down gently. No one needs to get hurt.

lines.t: ...He's right, Bhaskar. Put them down.
Fine. Take them.

choices.text: The village already knows your faces.

lines.t: ...Then running is pointless. Here.
The vessel, the rosette, and the manuscript. All three, unharmed.
You have returned more than objects. You returned our memory.
The festival can begin at sunrise!

objectives.title: Speak with Pujari Ananda
objectives.instruction: Walk to the priest at the temple steps and talk to him.
objectives.keys: WASD to walk, E to talk
hints: Someone at the temple needs your help.
The priest in white stands near the temple steps ahead.
Walk to Pujari Ananda and press E when the prompt appears.

objectives.title: Ask Meera what she saw
objectives.instruction: Find Meera in the courtyard and talk to her.
hints: A witness was awake before sunrise.
Meera wears a red and green saree, near the priest.
Walk to Meera and press E.

objectives.title: Enter the storage hall
objectives.instruction: Go through the temple doorway into the storage hall.
objectives.keys: WASD to walk, E at the doorway
hints: The theft happened inside the temple.
The doorway is at the top of the temple steps.
Walk into the glowing doorway and press E.

objectives.title: Search the storage hall
objectives.instruction: The hall is dark. Turn on your flashlight, then inspect 3 clues.
objectives.keys: G flashlight, F inspect, Esc close
hints: It is too dark to see details. Use your flashlight.
Press G, then look at the stands, the lock and the floor.
Press G, walk to each glowing item and press F.

objectives.title: Tell the Pujari what you found
objectives.instruction: Talk to Pujari Ananda about the clues.
hints: The priest knows the hall best.
Pujari Ananda is in the hall with you.
Walk to the priest and press E.

objectives.title: Go to the outer shrine
objectives.instruction: Follow the passage to the outer shrine.
objectives.keys: WASD to walk, E at the exit
hints: The thieves left another way.
A passage leads to the outer shrine.
Walk to the passage marked Outer Shrine and press E.

objectives.title: Examine the shrine
objectives.instruction: Inspect the red silk and the escape sketch.
hints: Something was torn on the way out.
Check the doorframe and the ground near the lamp.
Walk to each glowing item and press F.

objectives.title: Compare the evidence
objectives.instruction: Open the forensic kit and match the bootprints and the red silk.
hints: Think about what two boot sizes mean.
Two sizes means two people. The silk is red.
Press K, answer 2 (two people), then 2 (Bhaskar's red scarf).

objectives.title: Work out who did it
objectives.instruction: Talk to the Pujari and put the clues together.
hints: You have enough clues now.
Discuss them with Pujari Ananda.
Walk to the priest and press E.

objectives.title: Follow the trail to the old wall
objectives.instruction: Take the exit toward the ancient wall.
objectives.keys: WASD to walk, E at the exit
hints: The trail continues.
The exit to the ancient wall is past the shrine.
Walk to the exit marked Surya Chakra Wall and press E.

objectives.title: Hear the legend of the wall
objectives.instruction: Talk to Pujari Ananda about the wall.
hints: The priest remembers an old story.
Pujari Ananda stands near the wall.
Walk to the priest and press E.

objectives.title: Open the sun wall
objectives.instruction: Turn the symbols: lotus, conch, wheel, kalash. Then the centre wheel.
objectives.keys: E to use, 1-3 pick ring, W/S turn
hints: The scroll gave an order.
Lotus, conch, wheel, kalash must face the sun at the top.
Use the wall (E), set each ring with 1-3 and W/S in that order, then turn the centre.

objectives.title: Go through the open passage
objectives.instruction: Walk through the passage into the jungle.
objectives.keys: WASD to walk, E at the passage
hints: The wall has opened.
The passage is in the wall.
Walk into the passage and press E.

objectives.title: Follow the two men unseen
objectives.instruction: Stay behind them. When they look back, crouch or hide behind rocks.
hints: Keep your distance and watch them.
When they stop and turn around, crouch or stand behind a rock.
Stay about 8 m behind, hold C when the panel says they are looking back.

objectives.title: Confront the two men
objectives.instruction: Approach Bhaskar and Kishore and talk calmly.
hints: The thieves are ahead.
Two men argue in the clearing near the torches.
Walk to Bhaskar (red scarf) and press E.

objectives.title: Recover the three pieces
objectives.instruction: Pick up the vessel, the rosette and the manuscript.
hints: They set the pieces down.
The three pieces lie on the ground near the men.
Walk to each glowing piece and press F.

objectives.title: Return the pieces to the Pujari
objectives.instruction: Give the three pieces back to Pujari Ananda at sunrise.
hints: The temple is waiting.
Pujari Ananda is at the temple steps.
Walk to the priest and press E.

ending.text: Every temple holds a story. Every artifact carries a memory. Protecting heritage means protecting our history.
ending.title: MISSION COMPLETED
